# Documentation index

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen docs-index`.

This is the one index of every document under docs/. It lists each document with the status in its header.

Each hand-written document starts with a header block (Status, Owner, Decisions) in this vocabulary, and the DOC003 rule checks it:

- `current`: decided and, where it names code, built.
- `draft`: decided or proposed but not (fully) built, or still under review.

- `historical`: kept as a record; nothing new is built from it.
